snippet.title: Burden Street Station — Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126340/Burden_Street_Station/

God went missing, and it's your job to uncover this mystery. Shapeshift your way through a diverse roster of locals. Befriend, manipulate, encourage, threaten, change others by changing yourself.

Do whatever, but always remember — do not be inefficient.

OUT ON MAY 21ST
